name: Mihoshi
source:
Side character of episode 2
[url=/c92656]Misora[/url]'s younger sister. Works in a private cram school where she teaches people how to use MP and TPN properly.
Upon hearing about [url=/c92658]Chisa[/url]'s disappearance and [url=/c92661]Ginji[/url]'s rescue plan, she decided to go with him into the mountain.
